privacyPolicy.changesBody: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. Changes that materially affect you will be announced on the site rather than made quietly.
privacyPolicy.childrenBody: The site is not intended for children under 16. If you believe a child has an account here, tell us and we will remove it.
privacyPolicy.collectBilling: Membership. If you buy a membership, Stripe handles the payment. We store only the customer and subscription identifiers Stripe gives us, and the status of that subscription. Card details never reach our servers.
privacyPolicy.collectPlay: How you play. Every finished game — the moves, clocks, time control, result and both ratings before and after — plus a rating for each time control, your friends list, anyone you have blocked, and a count of how many signed-in members have viewed your profile.
privacyPolicy.collectProfile: What you enter yourself. A username, and optionally a country, a short status, a location, a flair and a profile picture.
privacyPolicy.collectReports: Reports. If you report another player, or are reported, we store the report, the reason and who filed it, so moderators can act on it.
privacyPolicy.collectSignIn: From your sign-in provider. Signing in with Discord, GitHub or Facebook gives us your name, email address, avatar image and the account identifier that provider uses for you, along with the tokens it issues so your session works. We never see your password for that provider.
privacyPolicy.collectTechnical: Technical. Our servers keep ordinary request logs, and the game server holds a short-lived token so you can drop back into a game after a refresh.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: For anything on this page, including any of the rights above, write to:
privacyPolicy.cookiesAnalytics: There is an analytics switch, and nothing is collected through it today. If that ever changes it will stay off until you turn it on.
privacyPolicy.cookiesChoice: Your cookie answer itself is stored in your browser rather than on your account — so answering on your laptop does not answer for your phone. You can change or withdraw it at any time from the privacy settings.
privacyPolicy.cookiesNecessary: Always on: a cookie holding your sign-in session, one that protects forms against cross-site submission, one remembering your language, and a token that returns you to a game in progress. Without these you cannot sign in or stay in a game.
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains what Esahist.ro stores about you, why, and what you can do about it. It describes what the site actually does — if anything here stops matching the site, this page is wrong and should be fixed.
privacyPolicy.keepingBody: Your account and its data are kept while the account exists. Ask us to delete it and we will remove your account, your profile and your personal details. Finished games are the exception: a game has two players and a rating history behind it, so games remain, with your username replaced. Backups and server logs age out on their own within a short period.
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: What Esahist.ro collects when you play, why, who it is shared with, and the rights you have over it.
privacyPolicy.publicBody: Read this part carefully, because it is the part people are most often surprised by. Your profile is public and can be found by search engines. Your username, the display name your sign-in provider gave us, your picture, country, status, location and flair, your ratings and record, your finished games, your friends list and your profile view count are all visible to anyone on the internet — not only to signed-in members.
privacyPolicy.publicNotShown: Your email address is never shown on the site, and neither is your block list.
privacyPolicy.rightsBody: Because the site is run from Romania and serves the EU, the GDPR applies. You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, ask us to delete it, ask us to restrict or stop a particular use, and ask for it in a portable form. Write to us and we will answer within a month.
privacyPolicy.rightsComplaint: If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Romanian supervisory authority, the ANSPDCP (dataprotection.ro), or to the authority where you live.
privacyPolicy.sharingAuth: Discord, GitHub and Facebook — only to sign you in. What they receive is governed by their own policies.
privacyPolicy.sharingBody: Only the services needed to run the site, each acting on our instructions:
privacyPolicy.sharingHosting: Our hosting provider, which runs the servers and the database.
privacyPolicy.sharingNever: We do not sell personal data, we do not share it for advertising, and we do not pass it to anyone else unless the law requires it.
privacyPolicy.sharingStripe: Stripe — payments and subscriptions, if you buy a membership.
privacyPolicy.sharingUploads: UploadThing — storage for profile pictures you upload.
privacyPolicy.summary: In short: there is no advertising, nothing is sold, and nothing is handed to data brokers. What we hold is what a chess site needs to seat you in a game, give you a rating and let other players find you.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.whyBody: To run your account and seat you in games, which is the agreement you enter by signing up. To keep ratings, leaderboards and game archives, which is the service itself. To act on reports and keep the site usable, which is our legitimate interest in moderating it. And to meet the accounting obligations that come with taking payment.
